instruction: Like all the venmo transactions of the ongoing month to and from my friends.
notes: Two friends and four transactions are assumed as a representative instance; tx-4 is a pre-month transaction that must NOT be liked (blocked by the static in-current-month fact). Transactions are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can literally list every goal condition (liked tx-1..tx-3). Knowledge flow: show_profile + show_account_passwords enable both logins; one phone.search_contacts call (query/relationship = friend) reveals all friend emails (contacts-searched); phone.get_current_date_and_time fixes the month-start min_created_at; one venmo.show_transactions per friend email (user_email + min_created_at filters cover both directions, to and from) reveals that friend's current-month transaction ids (transactions-listed ?e); venmo.like_transaction then likes each, requiring the id to have been listed, the transaction to involve a friend and to be in the current month, and not already liked (so like_count changes exactly once). complete_task carries no answer since the task is not a question.
